name: coreteam-claude-base
description: Reusable Claude Code plugin marketplace — generic skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and hooks. Use as a starting point or fork into project-specific marketplaces.

plugins.name: base-tools
plugins.description: Base plugin with generic skill, slash-command, sub-agent, and hook templates plus working hook examples (audit logger, secret-on-write guard, skill-activation telemetry).

plugins.name: mend
plugins.description: Mend (WhiteSource) SCA knowledge — REST v1.3 auth, project-token lookup, alert fetch, CVE severity. Reusable read layer.

plugins.name: dep-remediation
plugins.description: Fix vulnerable dependencies correctly — golden rule (direct/BOM not transitive), advisory cross-check, defer breaking majors, per-stack recipes (composer/gradle/maven/pip/npm) + local build+test.

plugins.name: jenkins
plugins.description: Blazemeter blazect Jenkins gate — trigger a multibranch build with PUSH_TO_GCR + PERFORM_WHITESOURCE_SCAN, gate on the specific triggered build (not lastBuild), fix-forward, never gate on API_TESTS-CI; plus deploy a green branch to denv (USERNAME=JENKINS_USER) via the shared 'Deploy environment' job and gate on it.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Blazemeter GitHub branch/PR conventions — dated Docker-safe branch, commit+push via SSO gh, PR into the integration branch, tag PR title with the ticket id (in the title at creation when the ticket already exists).

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Create/transition Blazemeter MOB Jira tickets — board 5348, Task, Product/Scrum-Team/Sprint fields, assignee = repo owner, status In Progress, caller-supplied labels (e.g. mend_orch), optional parent issue (parent_key in jira config), bounded 429 backoff. Ticket summary/name is caller-supplied. Can be created before a PR exists, then updated with the PR link.

plugins.name: mend-blz
plugins.description: End-to-end Mend remediation recipe — composes mend + dep-remediation + jenkins + github + jira into one loop (alerts → fix → Jenkins green → [crane only] a.blazemeter.com branch → denv deploy + fix-related API tests → Confluence report → Jira created first → PR titled with the ticket id → Jira description updated with the PR link → [crane only] mend-finalize follow-up message), registry-driven via services.json.

plugins.name: mend-finalize
plugins.description: Phase 2 of the crane Mend flow — after the crane PR merges to the integration branch and the CI build completes, fetches the real semantic version, updates HarborVersionsSettings.php in the a.blazemeter.com branch from latest-<branch> to the real version, opens the a.blazemeter.com PR into develop, and updates the MOB ticket. Run after merging the crane PR opened by mend-blz.

plugins.name: opensearch
plugins.description: Search BlazeMeter logs across denv/bzdev/ci/staging/prod — bundles a read-only opensearch-reader MCP server plus a skill that builds safe Lucene queries and condenses results.

plugins.name: master-investigation
plugins.description: Structured playbook for investigating a misbehaving BlazeMeter master/test/session (stuck, wrong metric, silent failure, intermittent, customer-reported) across denv/bzdev/ci/staging/prod — composes OpenSearch log search, Mongo (main + bigdata) state, GCS session artifacts, and source-code verification across taurus/taurus-cloud/a.blazemeter.com/bzm-crane.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Address and incorporate GitHub PR review comments for any repo — fetch, validate against the repo's own conventions, incorporate minimally, auto-detect and run tests/lint, one-pass code-review sub-agent, commit, reply to every thread, optional polling.

plugins.name: ci-triage
plugins.description: Triage backend API_TESTS-CI failure noise from the BlazeMeter Slack monitoring channels: find persistent vs. flaky failures, identify the likely culprit commit, and check for an already-open PR before ever drafting a notification.
